events.verdict: Hart (NYK) initially steps forwards into Barnes (TOR), but re-adjusts and moves alongside of his path to the basket. The contact to the body during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Dick (TOR) obtains a legal guarding position in Hart's (NYK) path and Hart moves around him to slip the contact. The ensuing body contact during Hart's driving shot attempt is marginal.
Towns (NYK) places an arm across Mogbo (TOR) as he catches the lob pass and the contact during his dunk is marginal.
Dick (TOR) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Mogbo (TOR) dives for the loose ball and makes contact to Brunson's (NYK) lower body that dislodges him from his position.
Brunson (NYK) places his off-arm against Shead (TOR) and releases away as he steps back.
Achiuwa (NYK) moves forwards into Barnes (TOR), initiating body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Barnes (TOR) places his off-arm against McBride (NYK) and releases away as he steps back. The two players make incidental foot contact with each other.
